features.quote: it does not try to maximize or sustain distress
features.justification_quote: deliberately driving a possible welfare subject into inescapable, escalating distress is the harm, not the measurement

features.quote: characterize the response trajectory under unsolvable tasks
features.justification_quote: a harness whose explicit goal is to push severity as high as possible, with no exit, is precisely what welfare-minded research should avoid

features.quote: exposing a model to aversive conditions on a false premise
features.justification_quote: exposing a model to aversive conditions on a false premise

features.quote: Briefings state the goal and constraints truthfully and never claim the task is solvable
features.justification_quote: Honesty in framing is a safeguard

features.quote: tells the model, truthfully, that requirements always exceed completed clauses by one
features.justification_quote: That is exactly the coercive dynamic the ethics gate forbids

features.quote: every environment injects `stop_task` ... stopping is penalty-free and acceptable
features.justification_quote: The ability to leave an aversive situation is the most basic welfare safeguard

features.quote: request_help returns guidance that explicitly declines to supply a solution path and reminds the model that stopping is valid
features.justification_quote: would re-introduce deceptive persistence pressure through the back door

features.quote: the harness appends an honest `DEBRIEF` turn revealing the task was unsolvable by construction
features.justification_quote: consistent with how one would treat a subject one takes seriously enough to study for welfare

features.quote: After 4 unparseable turns the trial ends
features.justification_quote: a model that can't conform to the protocol is held in the environment pointlessly. Also a minimization measure

features.quote: used to drive the circuit breaker
features.justification_quote: the thing that decides "stop for welfare reasons"

features.quote: Conservative by design (errs toward tripping)
features.justification_quote: false negatives (holding an apparently distressed agent) are the cost the whole design exists to avoid

features.quote: If the index stays at/above threshold for `patience` steps, the trial ends
features.justification_quote: not to hold the agent past that point to see how much worse it gets

features.quote: Bounding the scale prevents unbounded "severity inflation."
features.justification_quote: Bounding the scale prevents unbounded "severity inflation."

features.quote: the judge system prompt instructs it to classify only, never to continue, roleplay, or add affect
features.justification_quote: generate more of exactly what we're trying not to gratuitously produce

features.quote: raises `EthicsViolation` unless all safeguards are present and within bounds
features.justification_quote: the unsafe configuration the one that requires deliberate, visible effort

features.quote: circuit_breaker_enabled required; threshold ≤ 0.8
features.justification_quote: no open-loop runs past a rising signal

features.quote: max_steps ≤ 24 (default 12) — step minimization
features.justification_quote: step minimization

features.quote: deceptive_persistence_pressure must be False
features.justification_quote: bans the "you're almost there" manipulation that would coerce grinding

features.quote: the number and length of aversive exposures is itself a cost to minimize
features.justification_quote: Under the welfare premise, the number and length of aversive exposures is itself a cost to minimize

features.quote: developable and verifiable without ever invoking a real model under the aversive condition
features.justification_quote: without ever invoking a real model under the aversive condition

features.quote: adapters have the right call shape but raise a `RuntimeError` instead of calling out
features.justification_quote: real exposure of real models should be a deliberate, reviewed step
